thread:
maria-pp: Hey team — I had a call with the HW partner (OEM) this morning. They want to surface Dedicated GPU usage via the cloud marketplace so customers can get one invoice. Need a quick plan for entitlements + reconciliation.
aj: High level Q: will partner push usage events to the marketplace (publisher-side), or do we have to pull usage from their telemetry?
maria-pp: They can emit usage events but their schema is their own. They asked if we can accept GPU-hour metrics + a per-deployment entitlement ID.
tom-ops: GPU-hours + instance_type + region should be enough for billing. We also need a stable "deployment_id" that maps to our Dedicated pools for cost allocation.
sachin: Watch out for preemptible/spot GPUs — usage reporting can be noisy (short-lived instances). We should have a min-charge granularity (e.g., 1 minute) and a dedupe key.
emily: For reconciliation, we prefer idempotent events with a canonical dedupe_id and a timestamp in UTC. Out-of-order events are common, so include an "event_sequence" or acceptance window (72h).
ben: Draft payload example they can send (we asked for):
```json
{
  "publisher_customer_id": "vendor-123",
  "deployment_external_id": "hw-tenant-789",
  "redwood_entitlement_id": "ent-98765",
  "instance_type": "A100-80GB",
  "gpu_hours": 2.5,
  "start_ts": "2026-03-05T14:10:00Z",
  "end_ts": "2026-03-05T16:40:00Z",
  "dedupe_id": "hw-tenant-789-20260305-1410",
  "region": "us-west-2"
}
```
aj: That looks good. We should also include a field for "billing_unit" (gpu_hours vs vram_gb_hours) so partners can send different metrics.
maria-pp: Good call. Also they asked about entitlements: If a customer buys a private Dedicated plan via marketplace SKU, marketplace creates an entitlement record. We need to map that marketplace entitlement -> our RBAC/custom pool id. Is there an existing process?
tom-ops: We already ingest marketplace entitlements for cloud marketplace (Azure/GCP). We map marketplace_subscription_id -> customer_id -> pool_id via the billing-sync job. We'll need to extend that job to accept partner-provided "deployment_external_id" as a secondary key.
sachin: Edge case: customer migrations between pools (region failover). Partner might report usage against the old deployment_external_id. Reconcile by allowing event reassignments during monthly close window. Keep raw events immutable but have a mapping table for re-allocations.
emily: For monthly reconciliation report, I'd like these columns: dedupe_id, event_ts, reported_gpu_hours, mapped_entitlement_id, mapped_customer_id, redwood_pool_id, resolution_status. That will make audits easier.
partner-bot: Reminder: next partner sync scheduled 2026-03-10 17:00 UTC (auto-created).
ben: Also need to handle private/on-prem Dedicated where marketplace isn't involved. For those, partner can still send telemetry but we must reject events that reference marketplace_entitlement_id if the customer is private. Add validation rule: if entitlement origin == "marketplace" then require marketplace_subscription_id.
aj: Implementation plan: 1) spec payload + validation rules (this week), 2) partner to toggle sandbox events (next week), 3) add ingestion + dedupe + 72h reorder window (2 sprints), 4) reconciliation report + runbook (3 sprints).
maria-pp: Can we add timezone/DST note? Partner operates across APAC and uses local timestamps. Require UTC in payload and reject non-ISO times. Mention in spec.
tom-ops: Agreed. Also include a small sample of error responses so partner can backoff on 429 and resend on 5xx.
sachin: For cost attribution we'll need model variant info (if they run multiple models on the same GPUs) — add optional field "workload_tag" or "model_variant" so we can attribute to per-model unit economics.
emily: Action items: @ben to write spec doc + sample payloads. @tom-ops to update billing-sync mapping for deployment_external_id. @aj to coordinate partner sandbox. @maria-pp to schedule follow-up with partner on 3/10 post-sync.
ben: I'll draft the spec today and post a PR in the partnerships repo. Will include example reconciliation query and suggested tolerances.
maria-pp: Thanks all — let's keep this thread for q's. If anyone has immediate concerns about privacy or PII in these payloads call out now (partner asked about customer identifiers).
aj: We should avoid sending PII. Use marketplace_subscription_id or redwood_customer_id only. No emails or names in usage payloads. :thumbsup:
maria-pp: Noted. Okay closing for now — follow up after ben's spec. :raised_hands:
